join.title: Join room
join.roomPasswordOptional: optional if the room is not protected
join.notFound: This share link is invalid or the session no longer exists.
join.passwordRequired: This room is password-protected. Enter the password below.

history.title: History
history.diffLegend: Compared to the current document — highlights show what differs.

kanban.hint: Drag a card onto a column to move it. Double-click or pencil: edit in a pop-up (Markdown and tags). Use the tabs above to filter cards by tag.
kanban.modalTagsHint: Comma-separated tags; stored as YAML list « tags » (singular « tag » is removed to avoid duplicates).

home.title: Markpad
home.subtitle: Collaborative Markdown · web & Obsidian
home.lead: Create an account with just your email: we send a magic link (no password to remember). Once signed in, copy your user id into the Obsidian plugin to tie shares to your account.
home.accountBody: Sign-in and sign-up use the same flow: enter your email and open the link you receive (or copy it from server logs if SMTP is not configured).
home.signupPaused: New registrations are temporarily disabled on this server. Existing accounts can still sign in.
home.collabBody: Open a shared room to edit live in the browser or join from Obsidian.
home.pluginHint: In Obsidian: set the server URL, then paste the sign-in token copied from My account after email sign-in.

me.title: My account
me.subtitle: Passwordless sign-in and your shares
me.intro: Enter your email to receive a sign-in link. After opening the link, copy the token into the Obsidian plugin settings to create shares.
me.sentHint: If SMTP is configured, check your inbox. Otherwise the link is printed in the Markpad server console.
me.noToken: No token in this browser yet. Open the link from your email first (verification page).
me.emptyShares: No shares for this account. Sessions created from the plugin with your token will show up here.
me.errorNetwork: Cannot reach the server. Check VITE_SERVER_BASE_URL and your network.
me.errorSend: Could not send the link. Check the email or server configuration.
me.errorSmtpTimeout: The SMTP server did not respond in time (wrong host/port or firewall). Use the SMTP host from your mail provider, not necessarily your website domain.
me.errorSmtpHost: Connection refused or SMTP host not found. Check SMTP_HOST (e.g. smtp or ssl0 for OVH) and port (465 or 587).
me.errorSmtpAuth: SMTP authentication failed. Check SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS, and that the mailbox allows outbound SMTP.
me.errorSession: Session expired or invalid. Request a new link.
me.signupDisabled: New sign-ups are closed. If you already have an account, use the same email; otherwise contact an administrator.
me.verifiedBanner: You are signed in. Copy the token below into the Obsidian plugin settings.
me.jwtPluginHint: Paste this token into Markpad settings in Obsidian (“Sign-in token” field). It lets you create and delete your shares.

verify.expired: This link was already used or has expired. Request a new link from My account.
verify.signupDisabled: Account creation is disabled on this server. Ask an administrator for access, or use an email that is already registered.

admin.title: Administration
admin.confirmDeleteShare: Delete this session and its index entry? The collaborative document will be removed from the server.
admin.noToken: Sign in on My account with an administrator.
admin.cannotDeleteSelf: You cannot delete your own account here.
admin.allowPublicSignupHint: When off, only emails already in the database can receive a sign-in link. New addresses are rejected.
admin.chatRetentionHint: Messages older than this are deleted automatically (server-wide, by server timestamp).
admin.featuresHint: These apply to everyone opening /share/... links; values are read when the page loads.
admin.featuresAdvancedHint: Controls Kanban (Obsidian Bases) and Markdown table rendering in the web client.
admin.featuresModulesHint: Chat, history, and navigation; separate from extended Markdown preview.
admin.featureKanbanHint: Column board for Obsidian Bases (table/kanban views with groupBy on a note property).
admin.featureMarkdownTablesHint: HTML table preview plus in-editor table highlighting. The Markdown source is unchanged.
admin.featureChatHint: Side panel and messaging WebSocket; REST returns 403 when disabled.
admin.featureHistoryHint: Snapshots and diff; REST endpoints return 403 when disabled.
admin.featureFolderTreeHint: Sidebar to browse paths in folder shares; content still syncs without the tree.
